newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.
Vessels: Southway loading 15,138 tonnes using big bags. Waiting to dock, seven vessels to load using big bags and three to load bulk.
Road: 120 trucks carrying sugar arrived on June 12.
Loading: 3,534 tonnes sugar using big bags.
Vessels: A. Alandar loading 20,000 tonnes bulk sugar, Symplea
loading 13,000 tonnes bagged sugar, Gemstar I loading 13,000
bagged sugar, Cormorant, Fulvia, Tong Cheng and Daiana P each
loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Waiting to dock, three
vessels to load bagged sugar and two to load bulk. At Cargill
private terminal, no vessels docked, one vessel waiting to dock
Stocks: 39,961 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged
sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock
